newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SMB United active on retail interest.
newsitem.headline: SMB United active on retail interest.

text.p: Switchgear maker SMB United dominated the actives in Friday morning trade in Singapore with more than 23 million shares traded on strong retail interest, dealers said.
At 0230 GMT, the shares were up Singapore $0.03 to S$0.375.

"It's purely speculative and not fundamentally-drivened. There is a feel good factor among retail investors at the moment and that's what will be driving cheaper stocks up in the near term," said a dealer.
Company officials were not available for comment on the activity in the stock.
